title: The seawall in April rain
logline: The seawall in April rain, empty, the bench dark with wet, and on the wall in chalk a crab someone drew before the rain, half gone. Whose: the page suspects and doesn't say.

panels.composition: A seawall in April rain with an empty wet bench and a chalk crab drawn on the wall half washed away.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall in April rain with an empty wet bench and a chalk drawing of a crab on the wall half washed away, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
